{{Combat}} [[Southmire Orchard]] | affiliation = [[Gilneas (kingdom)|Kingdom of Gilneas]], [[Black dragonflight]], [[Forsaken]], [[Bloodclaw pack]], [[Nighthowl pack]], [[Darkpelt pack]] | loc = Southwestern [[Lordaeron]] }} '''Gilneas''' is a human nation and kingdom located in the peninsula directly south of [[Silverpine Forest]] on the continent of [[Lordaeron]]. The kingdom was founded following the breaking of Arathor and is ruled by the Greymane dynasty. Besides the peninsula, the kingdom also included the island of [[Zul'Dare]]. Gilneas is a large peninsula that juts into the sea south of western Lordaeron. Silverpine Forest lies to the northeast and [[Kul Tiras]] awaits across the sea to the south. Lord [[Genn Greymane]] never supported the Lordaeron Alliance in the Second War. Thus, after the war, he constructed the [[Greymane Wall]]: a massive barrier spanning the entire northern border. The enormous wall barricades Gilneas from Lordaeron. Gilneas does not allow anyone in or out, and none knows what has been transpiring there since the end of the Second War. ==History== :''For the history of the kingdom, see [[Gilneas (kingdom)#History|the History section on the Kingdom of Gilneas]].'' ==Geography== Ten years ago, Gilneas was a cold, rainy place and it has not changed much. Gilneas was also known for its harsh winters.[[The Silverpine Wars]][https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/wowpedia/images/5/58/Warcraft2Console_PlayStation_Azeroth_map.jpg/revision/latest?cb=20200506122945 Map of the Eastern Kingdoms from Warcraft II: The Dark Saga] Ocean surrounds the peninsula on three sides, making sea storms common. High cliffs on the shores protect Gilneas from sailors’ curious eyes. The Greymane Wall is the only evident site in Gilneas that is visible from the outside. The instanced dungeon [[Gilneas City]] can be found in this area.
